Input grammar:
- Root: `{"version":1,"traces":[TRACE,...]}`. Exactly these keys.
- Trace IDs unique, match `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}`.

- Each TRACE: `{"id":ID,"config":CONFIG,"events":[EVENT,...]}` — exactly these keys.
- CONFIG has exactly the listed keys.

Validation details:
- Reject duplicate object keys, non-finite numbers, invalid UTF-8, trailing JSON, unknown keys, wrong types, out-of-domain values, structural limits.
- On invalid input output exactly `{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}`.

Structural limits:
- Request at most 16 MiB, at most 32 traces, 20000 events, 20000 packets, 60000 frames, 2 MiB decoded frame data total. These counts include discarded packets.

- install live -> no-op.
- install discarded -> no-op.

Pending packet: consumes one queue slot until processed/dropped, even if auth will fail. Retain original event/packet indices, but processing time is the current key event's t.
